# Dictionary data — provenance and scope

The app bundles `app/src/main/assets/main_isv.combined` as its prediction /
swipe dictionary.

**What it is:** a list of Interslavic word **forms** with corpus frequencies
only — `word=…,f=…` lines. **No definitions, translations, glosses, or other
dictionary content.**

**How it was made:** the forms are machine-generated by an inflection engine
from a lemma list compiled from various Interslavic lexical
resources; the frequencies are derived from a text corpus.

**License / ownership:** the app's **code** is MIT (see the repository `LICENSE`).
**No ownership of, or license over, the underlying lexical data is claimed.** The
data is included solely to support this free, non-commercial tool for the
Interslavic language. Individual word spellings and frequency counts are facts,
not copyrightable expression.

If you are a rights-holder of any source and have a concern, please open an issue
at https://github.com/radoslove/keyboard-interslavic.
